title: 超越情感分析：传统NLP与基于LLM的多维分析在政治新闻评估中的比较
summary: 该研究比较了基于RoBERTa的传统情感分析与基于LLM的多维框架分析在50篇政治新闻中的应用。发现传统情感分析存在“中性崩溃”问题，70%的文章被归类为中性，而LLM方法能捕捉政治偏见、耸人听闻程度、情感诉求和框架，更符合社会科学研究需求。
summary_en: This study compares RoBERTa-based sentiment analysis with an LLM-based multi-dimensional framing analysis on 50 political news articles. It finds that traditional sentiment analysis suffers from 'neutral collapse', classifying 70% of articles as neutral, while the LLM approach captures political bias, sensationalism, emotional appeal, and framing, better aligning with social science research needs.
